title: A Desk Agent without the assignment permission can still read Round Robin Preferences and Team Assignment through the API
label: BUG
env: staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging) · agent "Customer Experience Specialists 2", profile Desk Agent (no "Manage assignment rules") · department QA AS6 Dept A

rows: Rules page and rules API, saving preferences
Blocked: screen message and 403 "Missing required permission 'desk:assignment:manage'"
Blocked like the rules: the screen says assignment rules, team assignment and assignment notifications need the permission
200: thresholds, agent thresholds, backlog and closure settings returned
